items.title: Disease-free survival and overall survival after neoadjuvant immunotherapy in mismatch repair-deficient colon cancer in the Netherlands: results of the single-arm, multicentre, phase 2, NICHE-2 trial.
items.original_title: Disease-free survival and overall survival after neoadjuvant immunotherapy in mismatch repair-deficient colon cancer in the Netherlands: results of the single-arm, multicentre, phase 2, NICHE-2 trial.
items.summary: Neoadjuvant immune checkpoint blockade induces high pathological response rates in patients with locally advanced mismatch repair-deficient (dMMR) colon cancer, yet long-term survival outcomes have not been established. Previously, we reported safety (a primary endpoint) and pathological response (a secondary endpoint) data from the NICHE-2 trial. Here, we report the primary efficacy endpoint of 3-year disease-free survival and the exploratory endpoint of 5-year overall survival. In this single-arm, multicentre, phase 2, NICHE-2 trial, patients with previously untreated, clinical stage 2 or 3, resectable dMMR colon cancer received a single dose of intravenous ipilimumab (1 mg per kg) on day 1, and two doses of intravenous nivolumab (3 mg per kg) on days 1 and 15, followed by surgery in one of the six participating hospitals in the Netherlands.

items.original_title: A Common CD36 Variant and the Genetic Landscape of Dilated Cardiomyopathy in Individuals of African Ancestry.
items.summary: Importance Dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) is a major cause of heart failure that disproportionately affects individuals of predominantly African ancestry, among whom familial clustering of disease is more pronounced relative to those of predominantly European ancestry. Truncating variants in TTN, which encodes the sarcomeric protein titin, are the most common established monogenic cause of DCM. A common CD36 nonsense variant enriched among individuals of African ancestry has also been shown to account for a substantial burden of DCM. Objective To compare the contribution of a CD36 nonsense variant to DCM risk with that of truncating variants in TTN and pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in other established genes for DCM.

items.original_title: Determinants of response to CAR T cell therapy in a multicenter, multi-trial cohort analysis of patients with lymphoma
items.summary: In patients with non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL) treated with chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy, factors associated with efficacy overlap with prognostic biomarkers. A high proportion of naive-like (CCR7+CD45RA+) T cells was the most significant feature associated with prolonged progression-free survival (PFS; hazard ratio = 0.46, 95% confidence interval: 0.31−0.68, P = 9.8 × 10−5, high versus low naive-like T cell groups) without impacting safety. In multivariate models, the naive-like phenotype outperformed clinicopathologic features such as inflammatory markers and tumor burden, remaining significant after adjusting for product expansion. The key findings were validated in an independent cohort of 203 patients treated with axi-cel-based therapy or brexucabtagene autoleucel.

items.original_title: Silent evaluation reveals context-dependent validity of automated metrics for AI-generated clinical messages
items.summary: Evaluation of AI-generated patient communication lacks standardized frameworks, and automated metrics may not reflect clinical utility. We leveraged a staged rollout of GPT-generated draft responses (GDRs) to patient portal messages. Thirty primary care physicians received drafts from September 2023 to August 2024 under two conditions: an intervention group where AI drafts were displayed and edited (n = 21,073), and a non-displayed group where drafts were generated but never shown to physicians, who composed responses independently (n = 45,127). We evaluated messages using BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, and Flesch Reading Ease, and then correlated automated metrics with blinded physician ratings of effectiveness, misunderstanding potential, and harm. In the intervention group, 2264 (11%) drafts were incorporated into final messages with high semantic alignment (BERTScore F1 = 0.93).

items.summary: Childhood cancer risk after assisted reproductive technology (ART) remains uncertain, particularly by procedure and cancer type. To examine associations between ART and childhood cancer overall and by ART modality and cancer type. Nationwide Danish cohort of 1 086 136 live-born children from 1996 to 2012, of whom 37 228 (3.4%) were conceived using ART, with follow-up through 2023. Maternal ART, classified as in vitro fertilization (IVF), intracytoplasmic sperm injection, or frozen embryo transfer. Incident childhood cancer. Cox proportional hazards models estimated hazard ratios (HRs); Poisson models estimated incidence rates. Non-ART births were the primary reference; secondary analyses used children of women with a history of infertility and children conceived using IVF as reference groups. During a median follow-up of 20 years, 3736 cancers occurred.

items.title: Endometrial ablation plus levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system versus endometrial ablation alone in women with heavy menstrual bleeding in The Netherlands (MIRA2): a multicentre, open-label, randomised, controlled, superiority trial.
items.original_title: Endometrial ablation plus levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system versus endometrial ablation alone in women with heavy menstrual bleeding in The Netherlands (MIRA2): a multicentre, open-label, randomised, controlled, superiority trial.
items.summary: Endometrial ablation is an established and effective treatment for women with heavy menstrual bleeding, but many patients require further treatment, with approximately 10% ultimately undergoing a hysterectomy within 2 years. The insertion of a levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system (LNG-IUS) immediately after endometrial ablation might inactivate residual untreated endometrium or prevent its regeneration, thereby preventing recurrent symptoms necessitating a hysterectomy. The aim of the study was to assess whether LNG-IUS insertion immediately after endometrial ablation in women with heavy menstrual bleeding reduced the need for subsequent hysterectomy within 2 years compared with endometrial ablation alone. This multicentre, open-label, randomised, controlled, superiority trial was conducted in 34 hospitals in the Netherlands.

recommendation_reasons.research: 多中心随机对照试验（34家医院、715例）显示子宫内膜消融后即刻置入LNG-IUS可使2年内子宫切除率从10%降至4%（RR 0.43），且不增加严重不良事件，为月经过多的治疗策略提供高等级证据；局限为开放标签设计及6%主要结局缺失，摘要级信息尚不足以评估长期结局。
